Our product

AX DetermMCU

Deterministic computing. Purpose-built silicon.

A deterministic, safety-oriented 32-bit RISC-V microcontroller architecture under development by Astrixcore Semiconductors.

Designed with a focus on predictable execution, real-time control, and demanding industrial applications.

Our engineering

From architecture to silicon.

Every breakthrough begins with an idea. Through architecture, engineering, verification, and rigorous validation, we are working toward transforming innovative concepts into real semiconductor technologies.

module event_matrix (
  input  wire clk, rst_n,
  input  wire [7:0] slot_cfg,
  output reg  [7:0] trigger
);
  // illustrative RTL, not product source
  always @(posedge clk) begin
    if (!rst_n) trigger <= 8'h00;
    else        trigger <= slot_cfg & tick;
  end
endmodule
